$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema for this file, typically "urn:shuv2code:schema:project-file".

iconPath.description: Workspace-relative path to the project icon (e.g. "assets/logo.svg"). Checked before shuv2code's built-in icon locations.

defaultThreadEnvMode.description: Where new threads start for this repository: "worktree" for a fresh git worktree, "local" for the current checkout. A per-project setting in shuv2code overrides this; when neither is set, the global default applies.

name.description: Display name for the script, shown in the shuv2code scripts menu.

command.description: Shell command executed in a shuv2code terminal at the project root.

icon.description: Icon shown next to the script in the scripts menu. Defaults to "play".

runOnWorktreeCreate.description: When true, the script runs automatically after a worktree is created for a new thread.

previewUrl.description: URL opened in the in-app browser preview when this script runs. Only honored on the desktop build.

autoOpenPreview.description: When true, automatically open the preview panel at `previewUrl` the moment the script starts.

items.description: A project script that team members can import into shuv2code.

scripts.description: Project scripts shared with everyone who opens this repository in shuv2code.

title: shuv2code project file
description: Checked-in project configuration for shuv2code (shuv2code.json at the repository root).
